_README: Floors for tools/ci/parity_ratchet.py, read from the committed published
measurements under docs/public/measurements/ (which CI already pins for
Metrics are '<source>:<dotted path into counts>'. Sources may name a
Floors move only by `parity_ratchet.py raise`, committed beside the change
that earned it. A drop that is genuinely intended stays a deliberate,
reviewable act -- never a side effect of regenerating a snapshot.
at_least  progress; falling is a regression
at_most   defect backlog; rising is a regression
exact     denominator; ANY change is a refusal, because every ratio
computed against it has to be re-read, not silently adopted
